prompt: Create a complete production 2D isometric RPG animation atlas STRICTLY based on the attached original character portrait. Preserve its exact design, silhouette, proportions, palette, face, clothing, equipment and limb anatomy. Same detailed small painted game-sprite style and elevated isometric viewpoint. Fully transparent RGBA background, no scenery, captions, grids or cast shadows. EXACTLY EIGHT COLUMNS and THIRTEEN ROWS = 104 separate whole articulated poses. Every complete character including wings and extended limbs must be SMALL, occupying at most 50 percent of the width and height of its cell. Large empty gutters, at least 25 pixels fully transparent on all sides of each pose and outer border. Never touch neighbors or clip body parts. Exact column direction order E, SE, S, SW, W, NW, N, NE. E is a strict right profile, SE front-right, S DIRECTLY FRONT facing the viewer, SW front-left, W strict left profile, NW back-left, N FULL BACK with no face visible, NE back-right. Do not reuse three-quarter front facing for side or rear directions. Keep each column's compass in every action. Rows exactly: 1 neutral idle; 2 visibly distinct breathing idle; 3 first walking/movement step; 4 passing movement phase; 5 opposite movement step; 6 attack windup; 7 attack CONTACT toward the facing direction; 8 attack recovery; 9 hit recoil; 10 hit recovery; 11 death buckling/falling begins; 12 falling close to ground; 13 final flat collapsed recognizable body, limbs connected. All 104 poses must be actually articulated and distinct, never repeated or merely translated. Constant whole-body scale throughout. Preserve this exact original LYCANTHROPE: fierce upright wolf humanoid with charcoal-black and slate-gray spiky fur, pale bony silver claws, pointed ears, original long wolf muzzle, shaggy spined shoulders/back, powerful digitigrade legs and two clawed hands. Retain the original gray chest fur and dark lower body, not the earlier brown werewolf. Do not add armor, clothes, weapons, horns or a glowing aura. Grounded bipedal stalk with bent digitigrade legs. Attack windup draws a clawed hand back, contact rakes those original claws in the column's facing direction, recovery retracts. Rear views show black spiky back fur with no front face; front view centered muzzle and both shoulders. Death ends collapsed on its side with original connected limbs and fur.

review.notes: Existing 4820.png identity retained: charcoal/slate spiky wolf fur, long muzzle, pointed ears, silver-gray chest and claws, hunched powerful digitigrade limbs. No new armor, clothes or weapons and no substitution of the separate brown werewolf. Eight front/side/rear stances, claw swipe, recoil and three connected collapse poses. Rear views retain back mane, front views retain muzzle/chest. Actual Main AI/projectiles/lifecycle must pass for every registered name before completion is counted.
